# Steward

Steward is a local-first personal memory and knowledge assistant.

## Sources

Original files remain authoritative. Source metadata records the current path and content hash.

## Source Fragments

Source fragments are derived data that preserve document headings and line locations. They can be rebuilt from original files.

## Provenance

Provenance connects derived evidence back to the original source.

## Lexical Retrieval

Lexical retrieval finds exact terms through an inverted index and ranks results with BM25.

## Activity

Activity events record what happened, when it happened, and which mutations were performed.
